# QCY

> > QCY is a leading manufacturer of wireless earbuds and headphones featuring advanced noise cancellation, Hi-Res audio, and extended battery life.

QCY specializes in premium true wireless earbuds with flagship models like MeloBuds Pro and MeloBuds N70 incorporating cutting-edge technologies such as LDAC Hi-Res Audio, adaptive ANC, and Bluetooth 6.0. The product lineup ranges from budget-friendly options to high-end models with extended playtime and advanced sound engineering.

## Key Topics

- QCY MeloBuds Pro
- QCY MeloBuds N70
- QCY H3 Pro
- LDAC Hi-Res Audio
- Adaptive ANC (Active Noise Cancellation)
- Bluetooth 6.0
- True Wireless Earbuds
- Hybrid ANC
- Extended Battery Life (40H-50H)
- ENC (Environmental Noise Cancellation)
- IPX5 Water Resistance
- Graphene Dynamic Drivers
- QCY App
- Noise-Cancelling Technology
- Hi-Res Audio Certification
